generator.program.note: The program the authors chose to grow this taxon's decurrent tree species (named in each species' spec until G2.3a moved it here).

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 1926), family 231 Oleaceae: trees, shrubs or climbers; leaves opposite, very rarely alternate, simple or pinnate; stipules absent; flowers regular; calyx lobed, rarely absent; petals often 4, free or joined, or absent (as in many ashes); stamens usually 2; ovary superior, 2-celled.
